items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: I held the job over there for him and Joe Glazer. Joe Glazer had the place.

ctx.x: Had a race. Yeah, him and Paul, they run. And he wasn't able, so he called my wife up and asked me to come down, and I held the job over there for him and Joe Glazer. Joe Glazer had the place. That's right, Joe Glazer.
